verdict.rationale: Firstbase's registered-agent page states "Registered Agent available in all 50 states" and "Foreign qualification available in all 50 states," with published per-state pricing of $299/year. Expanding to a new state is handled from the same compliance dashboard ("select a state... and we'll take care of it"), and per-state status tracking sits in one place. That directly covers the one-vendor, every-state story. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-state registered-agent coverage (all evidence is vendor-claimed), and no explicit mention of DC or territories beyond "50 states."
